locator.heading: Table A1 · Complete HFE results across all 29 models and 52 reasoning-effort configurations

protocol.tools: none（官方 §3.3：无搜索、无代码执行等外部工具）
protocol.shots: zero-shot（零样本，单轮，无系统提示）
protocol.run_count: 6 次抽样 / 题（每模型 3,264 次响应）
protocol.aggregation: pass@1 = c/n（n=6）；95% 区间用 family-clustered percentile bootstrap
protocol.judge: Gemini 3.1 Pro（temperature 0，确定性判分，二元 Yes/No）

benchmark_evidence.notes:
来源为 Google DeepMind 官方技术报告《Humanity's First Exam: Measuring the Reliability Floor of LLMs》（2026-11-24）Table A1「Complete HFE results across all 29 models and 52 reasoning-effort configurations」中本模型**最高评测 reasoning effort** 那一行；该表由发布方统一跑全部厂商模型并统一判分，不是各家自报，故 attribution_type=benchmark_owner_reported。
本行取该行的 pass@1 = 71.3%（95% 区间 ±5，family-clustered percentile bootstrap 半宽）。
同一行的其余读数（官方原始口径）：family pass@4 = 99.1%、family pass^4 = 36.9%（±7.9，可靠性地板）、Family Reliability Gap = 62.2 pp、平均思维 token 4,613。pass@1 与 family pass^4 不是同一量纲（后者要求同族 4 题 × 6 次抽样共 16 次全对才记成功），本仓跨模型对照只取 pass@1，family pass^4 的读数记在此处备查，完整表见基准档案《Humanity's First Exam》。
协议（报告 §3.3 / §3.2）：零样本、单轮、无系统提示、无外部工具（无搜索与代码执行）；多模态题按原始未裁剪图像字节输入；544 题每题抽样 n=6（每模型 3,264 次响应）；各厂商默认解码参数（temperature / top_p 官方未给具体值，故 protocol 对应键留 null）；判分为确定性模型 Gemini 3.1 Pro（temperature 0），剥除内部推理链后给二元 Yes/No；失败或空输出记 0 分。
官方把本模型标注为上一代模型（表内带 * 号），数值仅作参考，不代表当期水平。
推理档位差异不可横比：同一模型在低档位（low / minimal）的 family pass^4 会大幅下降（如 GPT-6.2 Astra xhigh 92.4% vs low 74.3%），跨模型读数时须留意各家档位定义不同（OpenAI xhigh / Anthropic max / Google high）。

notes: Release date 2026-05-28 from the newsroom index "May 28, 2026 - Introducing Claude Opus 4.8"; OpenRouter lists claude-opus-4.8 and 4.8-fast created 2026-05-27 (one-day listing lag). Prose carries no absolute vendor benchmark numbers - the entire capability table is image-only, so all vendor rows are pending with vision reads in notes. Honesty claim: about 4x less likely than its predecessor to let flaws in code it wrote pass unremarked. Alignment: misaligned-behavior rates substantially lower than 4.7, similar to Mythos Preview (chart image 40343dc4). Also launched: dynamic workflows in Claude Code (hundreds of parallel subagents, codebase-scale migrations); effort control UI in claude.ai/Cowork; Messages API system entries mid-task without breaking prompt cache. Pricing unchanged USD 5/25; fast mode USD 10/50. Forward-looking: Mythos-class general release "in the coming weeks" (Project Glasswing). Customer quotes not turned into rows: Super-Agent benchmark only model completing every case end-to-end; CursorBench exceeds prior Opus at every effort level (no numbers); Databricks Genie 61% cheaper token cost vs 4.7; Hebbia citation-precision gains.
